name: dishwasher_set_back_after_cleaning
hypothesis: Moving the appliance backward by 30 mm displaces both the pull bar and hinge from their calibrated positions. The taught grasp may miss or capture only partially; any captured grasp must then follow an arc centered on the wrong hinge.
expected_failure: Step 2 fails to capture or retain the pull bar, leaving the door below 85 degrees; partial capture may also cause unplanned contact during the imposed arc.
real_world_story: After wiping behind the dishwasher, someone leaves it three centimetres farther back.
